reviews.t: July 2023 - Worshipped at Montreat July 3 2022 with our family and many friends throughout the community. Anderson is a fantastic circular church with the organist in the center. We loved the original song mixed with traditional hymns. The visiting pastor shared a Moving sermon including a few photos projected for emphasis. I appreciated the bulletin’s in-depth description of the artwork that adorned the back of the “stage”. Thanks to ministers and staff sharing the gospel of Christ with us while we were away from our home church. Oct 2025 - As our pastor retired last month, we brought our Retreat members to worship with the Montreat Congregation. They made us feel very welcome even when we showed up with 50-60 extra people. Personally, I appreciated their prayers for my family on this difficult day.

I'm utterly shocked that Montreat Presbyterian Church doesn't have more reviews. It's the fantastic "host/home" church for the town of Montreat, NC, which is the home of PCUSA's conference center. It's home to an incredibly welcoming, kind, learned, and accepting group of people who never fail to make any visitors feel like they belong. We live elsewhere, but I'm always amazed at how much we are made to feel at home when we're in Monreat. If you're in the area, don't hesitate to attend - you'll go home with a bunch of new friends.
We are so fortunate to have such a beautiful inclusive church family lead by the best of the best!!!! That would be the Grogg and Hare dynamic duo!

I'm from out of town, went to this church for Easter Sunday, I must say, if I lived here I would attend forever, very beautiful church, service was outstanding, beautiful music, Absoulutly loved my experience
